summary: Compact ultrasonic range-finder module: a small rectangular PCB with a single cylindrical ultrasonic transducer mounted on its front face, a row of 7 through-hole header pads along one edge, and one larger mounting hole in a corner.

mountingSurfaces.description: Rear face of the PCB, flat, usable for mounting with the corner hole.
Front face of the cylindrical transducer (sensing face); keep unobstructed, not a mounting surface.

notes: Overall bounds come from the stated spec 0.870 x 0.785 x 0.645 in (22.1 x 19.9 x 16.4 mm). The assignment of x to the PCB width, y to the PCB height and z to the depth along the transducer axis is inferred from the photo; the source data is flagged unverified. Hole diameters and positions are not printed anywhere. They were roughly estimated from the photo using the 2.54 mm header pitch as a scale, so treat them as approximate. The transducer is a cylinder, roughly 16 mm in diameter by eye, protruding from the PCB front, but its size is not stated. The beam-pattern charts do not give physical part dimensions.
